No sign-in is needed for now. I’m happy for this to be a private, single-person app that I can reach from both devices.

Before implementation, though, the scope summary is missing several things I still expect:

- Select several bookmarks and add or remove tags, mark them read or unread, archive them, or delete them together. I also want the option to apply an action to every bookmark in the current search or view—not the entire collection accidentally.
- Sort bookmarks by date added, title, and similar useful choices.
- Save an offline copy of a page. A normal page should be kept as a single local page file; a PDF link should preserve the PDF instead. I’d also like the option to submit a page to the Internet Archive.
- Save a frequently used combination of search text plus included and excluded tags, so I can reopen that filtered collection later.
- Import and export a standard browser-bookmarks HTML file, retaining titles, tags, and original saved dates where available.
- Personal display choices such as the default sort, how many items are shown, and text size.

Please include these in the behaviour exploration before asking me to approve implementation.
